properties.text: Serial 2 started. RED ONE free to close the shipping lane.
Intention: transit west at slow speed towards the lane.
Intention: close RED ONE's last known position, then screen the lane.
Closest approach of BLUE ONE and RED ONE: 1.42 nmi.
Contact classified submarine, designated RED ONE, bearing 331.2°T.
Changing legs to resolve range on RED ONE.
RED ONE reports its simulated defect cleared.
Assessed held by BLUE ONE. Altering to the west-north-west.

True bearings from BLUE ONE to the target, with normally distributed error. Bow sonar: contact is possible only within detection range, outside the baffles and while the sonar is listening; within those limits it is gained and lost at random.

Towed array: further, and into the baffles, but not near its own axis (endfire) nor while turning hard; each cut carries the measured bearing and its mirror image about BLUE ONE's course, ambiguous until the analyst keeps one (CAP-22).
Bow sonar: 349 cuts; Towed array: 166 cuts, every one ambiguous. Each cut a feature of its own, on its sensor, carried by BLUE ONE.
Scripted narrative: each line read into a narrative entry, which belongs to the track of its platform where there is one.
The narrative is a supporting file, not a source: the builder wrote it.
Drew the exercise area as a shape annotation, annotation-exercise-area.
Exercise: the blue and red tracks, the sonar bearings, the exercise area and the narrative.
Background traffic: the AIS tracks.
